abilities.name: Fight on, fortunes of war II
Fight on, fortunes of war III

system.description: Run at up to 5× Speed, jump 25% farther with a running start, and get chase advantages while on foot.
Guess your opponent's chase Strategy; if right, they take a penalty equal to your Chase feats on their next Maneuver check.
No Maneuver penalty for going faster than half your vehicle or mount's top speed.
Impress gives synergy to your Maneuver checks, and Acrobatics/Drive give synergy to Impress when people can see you drive.
